headline: Emotional Mirza Abbas joins Parliament session for first time in 5 months
summary: The Dhaka-8 MP entered the house in a wheelchair and delivered an emotional speech that moved the assembly.
details: Mirza Abbas, the Member of Parliament for the Dhaka-8 constituency, attended a session of the 13th National Parliament for the first time in five months.
The MP arrived at the assembly in a wheelchair, marking a significant return to his legislative duties.
During the session, he delivered an emotional speech that reportedly left the entire parliament in a state of reflection.
His return and the emotional nature of his address have drawn significant attention within the government-party MP circles.
caption:
After 5 months, Mirza Abbas returns to Parliament in a wheelchair.

Mirza Abbas, the Member of Parliament for the Dhaka-8 constituency, attended a session of the 13th National Parliament for the first time in five months.

The MP arrived at the assembly in a wheelchair, marking a significant return to his legislative duties.

During the session, he delivered an emotional speech that reportedly left the entire parliament in a state of reflection.

His return and the emotional nature of his address have drawn significant attention within the government-party MP circles.

headline: Tk 276cr embezzlement: ACC approves case against Hasina and Rehana
summary: The Anti-Corruption Commission has filed a case against the ousted prime minister, her sister, and a former bank chairman over CSR fund misappropriation.
details: The Anti-Corruption Commission (ACC) has approved a case against ousted prime minister Sheikh Hasina, her sister Sheikh Rehana, and former Exim Bank chairman Mohammad Nazrul Islam Mazumder.
The case centers on the alleged embezzlement of Tk 276.30 crore in corporate social responsibility (CSR) funds.
These funds were reportedly collected from various banks specifically for the Bangabandhu Memorial Trust.
ACC Secretary Saidur Rahman Khan confirmed the development during a press briefing at the commission's headquarters today.
The three individuals are named as the primary accused in the misappropriation of the trust's funds.
caption:
Tk 276.30 crore embezzled? The ACC has approved a case against Sheikh Hasina and Sheikh Rehana over CSR fund misappropriation.

The Anti-Corruption Commission (ACC) has approved a case against ousted prime minister Sheikh Hasina, her sister Sheikh Rehana, and former Exim Bank chairman Mohammad Nazrul Islam Mazumder.

The case centers on the alleged embezzlement of Tk 276.30 crore in corporate social responsibility (CSR) funds.

These funds were reportedly collected from various banks specifically for the Bangabandhu Memorial Trust.

ACC Secretary Saidur Rahman Khan confirmed the development during a press briefing at the commission's headquarters today.

The three individuals are named as the primary accused in the misappropriation of the trust's funds.
